svg.title: How AI Usage Observatory is wired
svg.desc: Agent session records on your Mac feed five collectors inside the Observatory server on 127.0.0.1:4318. The collectors build an in-memory snapshot, backed by a local SQLite database, which your browser reads through /api. The optional quota-service companion on 127.0.0.1:8787 supplies provider allowance data. Four wires cross the edge of the machine: provider usage endpoints, the LiteLLM price list, the npm registry, and an optional Tailscale Serve path to your own devices.
svg.text: How AI Usage Observatory is wired
Everything inside the frame runs on 127.0.0.1. Four wires cross its edge, and each one says what it carries.
Signs in with the Claude Code Keychain item
IDs and folders, file heads only
Price list and ccusage releases. A collection never waits for them.
A React app that reads only the server's
normalized JSON, never the raw records.
Asks for a fresh dashboard every 60 seconds.
In development, Vite serves the UI and proxies /api.
Answers only the hostnames listed in
Anthropic and OpenAI, your own accounts

g.text: Fetched from outside. Sends no prompts, replies, or usage records.
Private path to your own devices
